name: SFPTECH
recent: SFP Tech 近期持续因员工行使 ESOS 而多次发行新股，同时有一名独立非执行董事 Joyce Wong Ai May 于 11 月 1 日获委任进入多个董事会委员会。公司 2026 年第二季度净利大幅增长至 RM7.4 million，并获交易所给予至 12 月 4 日的期限以符合审计委员会组成要求。
notable: Joyce Wong Ai May 获委任为独立非执行董事，并进入审计、薪酬与提名委员会，2026 年 11 月 1 日生效。
公司因员工行使 ESOS 而多次发行新股，最近一次涉及 275,100 股，上市日为 2026 年 11 月 13 日。
2026 年第二季度净利达 RM7.4 million，较上一季度增长 269.6%。
risks: 公司获交易所给予至 2026 年 12 月 4 日的期限，以符合审计委员会组成要求。
近期有多名大股东及董事申报持股变动，包括 MR LIM ZEE YANG、MR KEOH BENG HUAT、MISS TAN GEK IM 及 DATO' HAMZAH BIN MOHD SALLEH。
员工行使 ESOS 导致股本持续扩大，可能摊薄现有股东持股比例。
earnings: 2026 年第二季度营收为 RM39.1 million，环比增长 48.8%，同比增长 36.4%；净利为 RM7.4 million，环比增长 269.6%，同比增长 1181.6%；净利率从上一季度的 7.6% 升至 18.9%。

recent_en: SFP Tech has been issuing new shares repeatedly due to ESOS exercises, while independent non-executive director Joyce Wong Ai May was appointed to several board committees effective November 1. The company's 2Q2026 net profit rose sharply to RM7.4 million, and it has been given until December 4 by the exchange to meet audit committee composition requirements.
notable_en: Joyce Wong Ai May was appointed as Independent Non-Executive Director and member of the Audit, Remuneration and Nomination Committees, effective November 1, 2026.
The company issued new shares multiple times due to ESOS exercises, with the latest involving 275,100 shares listed on November 13, 2026.
2Q2026 net profit reached RM7.4 million, up 269.6% quarter-on-quarter.
risks_en: The company has been given until December 4, 2026 by the exchange to meet audit committee composition requirements.
Several substantial shareholders and directors have recently reported changes in their shareholdings, including MR LIM ZEE YANG, MR KEOH BENG HUAT, MISS TAN GEK IM and DATO' HAMZAH BIN MOHD SALLEH.
Continuous ESOS exercises have expanded share capital, potentially diluting existing shareholders' stakes.
earnings_en: 2Q2026 revenue was RM39.1 million, up 48.8% QoQ and 36.4% YoY; net profit was RM7.4 million, up 269.6% QoQ and 1181.6% YoY; net margin rose to 18.9% from 7.6% in the previous quarter.
